 2. Suggested themes for elaboration
at Workshop-III
Considering attribute 2 > Spa historic urban landscape color coding in the bldgs
construction development during the 19th c.
a) It would be interesting to examine, by means of a similar color coding, the
correlation between the current int’l ownership structure of the designated
area and impact of investments trends on the SoC in monitoring,
b) It would be interesting, for example, to observe how the types of ownership
impact the state of PE (buildings) in respect to investment developments
(i.e. improving and/or worsening trends in the preservation/conservation of
the PEs within each monitoring period.
c) Regime of monitoring and conservation should be considered in the context.

 3. Questions and clarifications
Nařízení vlády č. 430/2017 Sb. /excerpt, terminology re: therapeutic landscape/
„…Kulturními hodnotami v památkových rezervacích uvedených v odstavci 1 jsou
zejména architektonické, urbanistické, historické, umělecké, estetické a
krajinářské hodnoty, které dokumentují urbanistický, architektonický a kulturní
vývoj sídel, včetně rozvoje lázeňství, a vytvářejí jeho prostředí jako lázeňská
kulturní krajina.“ srv. termíny „terapeutická krajina“ a „láz. terapeut. krajina“.
Czech Gov. Regulation No. 430/2017 Coll. Re: “cultural” vs. “therapeutical” land.
Governmental Order on the Declaration of Selected Parts of the Towns of
Františkovy Lázně, Cheb, Karlovy Vary and Mariánské Lázně … with a Spa Cultural
Landscape as Historical Monument Reserves… etc.
This is a definition translated from paragraph 1 of the cited regulation above:
… „The cultural values in the conservation areas referred to [in said regulation]
shall be, in particular, architectural, urban, historical, artistic, aesthetic and
landscape values which document the urban, architectural and cultural
development of settlements, including spa development, and create its
environment as a spa cultural landscape.“ cf. w/ „(spa) therapeutic landscape“.
